title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 22: David's song of praise to Yahweh, his rock, fortress and deliverer.

questions.text: When did David speak the words of this song to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 22:1 says David spoke this song in the day Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies and out of the hand of Saul.

answers.text: When Yahweh delivered him from all his enemies and from Saul
When he brought the ark into Jerusalem
When he finished building his own house

questions.text: Complete the line: "Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my ..."
questions.explanation: David says that Yahweh is his rock, his fortress, and his deliverer.

questions.text: According to the song, what were around David?
questions.explanation: David sings that the cords of Sheol were around him and the snares of death caught him.

questions.text: From where did God hear David's voice when he called?
questions.explanation: David called on Yahweh in his distress, and he heard his voice out of his temple.

answers.text: From the top of Mount Sinai

questions.text: On what does the song say Yahweh rode and flew?
questions.explanation: The song says Yahweh rode on a cherub and flew, and was seen on the wings of the wind.

questions.text: Complete the line: "For you are my ..., Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness."
questions.explanation: David calls Yahweh his lamp and says that Yahweh will light up his darkness.

questions.text: According to David, what can he leap over by his God?
questions.explanation: David says that by Yahweh he runs against a troop, and by his God he leaps over a wall.

questions.text: God makes David's feet like what?
questions.explanation: David says God makes his feet like hinds' feet and sets him on his high places.

questions.text: God teaches David's hands to war, so that his arms can bend a bow of what?
questions.explanation: God teaches his hands to war, so that his arms bend a bow of bronze.

questions.text: In the last verse of the song, to whom does Yahweh show loving kindness?
questions.explanation: The song ends by saying Yahweh shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

answers.text: The foreigners who submit to David
The priests who serve in his temple
His anointed, David and his offspring
